The '''C5H4 virus''' was a very deadly virus that could be found in the [[The galaxy/Legends|known galaxy]]. A cure was finally discovered during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] by a [[Unidentified corporation (C5H4 virus)|corporation]], but they refused to let it out.<ref name="TCM">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Diplomacy|A Cure for What Ails You}}</ref> Eventually, a diplomat was sent to resolve the situation.<ref name="TCM" />
